key_insight: COΦ maps photonic quantum operations onto qubit circuits using truncated Fock-space encodings, bridging optical and digital quantum computing.
engineering_relevance: The Python compiler converts Blackbird quantum-optics programs into OpenQASM circuits, enabling digital simulation of low-photon-number optical systems.
method: Truncate each optical mode’s Fock space to a finite dimension.
Construct qubit representations of phase rotation, displacement, squeezing, and beam-splitter operations.
Provide explicit circuits for truncation dimensions N=2 and N=4.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports explicit circuit constructions and discusses benchmarking of implemented operations, but provides no quantitative performance results.
watch_item: Finite Fock-space truncation limits applicability when appreciable photon-number probability lies outside the retained states.
paper_title: CO$Φ$ - COmpiling PHotonics into dIgital quantum circuits
